collectors.titleDetails: (3 total Queries, 3 of them unique across 2 Connections)

queries.sql: SELECT tbl_module.id_module, tbl_module.nama_module, tbl_module.icon as micon, tbl_menu.id_menu, tbl_menu.path, tbl_menu.menu, tbl_menu.icon FROM `users` left join auth_groups_users on auth_groups_users.user_id = users.id LEFT join auth_groups_permissions on auth_groups_permissions.group_id = auth_groups_users.group_id left join auth_permissions on auth_permissions.id = auth_groups_permissions.permission_id left join tbl_module on tbl_module.id_module = auth_permissions.id left join tbl_menu on tbl_module.id_module = tbl_menu.id_module where users.username = 'muti' order by tbl_module.id_module,tbl_menu.menu

SELECT setup_kelas.nama_kelas kelas,count(`setup_kelas`.`id_kelas`) jml FROM `tbl_beasiswa` inner join tbl_ruangan on tbl_beasiswa.id_siswa = tbl_ruangan.id_siswa inner join setup_kelas on tbl_ruangan.id_kelas = setup_kelas.id_kelas inner join data_siswa on tbl_beasiswa.id_siswa = data_siswa.id_siswa where `tbl_beasiswa`.`peserta` = 'yes' and data_siswa.locked = 'no' group by `setup_kelas`.`id_kelas`,`tbl_beasiswa`.`persen`
